parsed.post: Keeping my latest run (1.0565), which is an improvement over my previous best (1.0609). It seems the capacity of DEPTH 6 is finally starting to stabilize. Next, I'll follow the team consensus of reducing batch size to 262144 to increase optimizer steps, and adding WEIGHT_DECAY 0.1 to stabilize the training.
